chunks: That which was contained in the previous report from His saying 'Bada (manifested/change) for Allah regarding Muhammad as He manifested regarding Ismail' means that a new matter appeared from Allah regarding his brother Hasan, and doubt and uncertainty remained regarding his Imamate. For a group of the Shia thought that the command (Imamate) was for Muhammad because he was the elder, just as a group thought that the command was for Ismail ibn Ja'far rather than Musa (peace be upon him). So when Muhammad died, it became clear from Allah's command regarding him that He did not appoint him as Imam, just as it became clear regarding Ismail that he was not the Imam. Not that there was a prior text appointing him and then Allah changed His decision in favor of another, for that is not permissible for Allah, the All-Knowing of the outcomes.

key_terms.بَدَا: Bada (manifestation or change in divine decree/appointment)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Bada regarding the Imamate of Muhammad ibn Ali according to Shaykh al-Tusi?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi clarifies that the 'Bada' regarding Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (al-Askari) signifies the manifestation of Allah's will rather than a change in His eternal knowledge, resolving the Shia doubt over whether the elder or younger brother was the Imam. He emphasizes that this is not a reversal of a fixed decree, as Allah, being the Knower of outcomes, appoints the Imam based on the unfolding reality of the situation. This explanation safeguards the doctrine of divine omniscience while acknowledging the historical confusion surrounding the Imamate during the Minor and Major Gheebah transitions.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: That which was mentioned in the previous report is based on the fact that change of destiny (Bada) occurred about Ismail as well as Muhammad. It means that with regard to the brother of Muhammad, Imam Hasan Askari (a.s), a new matter was revealed from Almighty Allah and this removed doubt about his Imamate, since some Shia thought that Imamate was fixed for Muhammad and he was the Imam, as he was elder to Imam Hasan Askari (a.s). They thought in the same way with regard to the Imamate of Ismail bin Ja’far and Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s) not being the Imam. Hence when Muhammad died, the command of Allah was revealed about him; that is he is not the Imam and that he is not appointed to Imamate, and the same was revealed with regard to Ismail previously. Not that previously a text based on his Imamate was mentioned and after that Allah changed His decision in favor of someone; as such a thing is impossible from Almighty Allah and He is aware of the end of all matters.
